plan.notes: Source: 'AS Business Administration - Suggested Plan of Study 2025-2026 Catalog' (Department of Management, Marketing, and Information Systems). DEGREE DISCREPANCY: the catalog publishes this as the ASSOCIATE OF SCIENCE (AS) in Business Administration ('# AS Business Administration'; 'associate of science (AS) degree'); the expected list labels it 'AA Business Administration'. Seeded as AS per the official catalog. The printed catalog table interleaves the Fall/Spring columns in the extracted text (Fall Semester 1 = ENGL 1113, Mathematics, HIST 2013 or HIST 2023, HIST 1003, FIN 2003; Spring Semester 2 = ENGL 1123, ECON 2203, Biological Science, Fine Arts/Humanities, IS 2053); rows are sequenced per the labeled Fall/Spring columns, not the interleaved text order. Gen-ed choice slots use first-listed option codes with choice=true; 'ACCT Elective' slots are major choice placeholders (choose two of ACCT 2103, ACCT 3023, ACCT 3033, ACCT 3053). The catalog adds: 'Please note that not all business major courses are guaranteed to be offered in a given academic year. Refer to your academic advisor or the registrar's office for further guidance.' Per-semester totals printed by the catalog (17/13/16/15) match the sequenced course sums; catalog degree total 61 ('Total hours for degree - 61') matches sequenced sum 61.
